Sun Data Analytics is an independent analytics practice focused on clear reporting, reproducible data work, research support, and practical decision systems.

## Background

Sun Data Analytics is led by Jonathon Sun. The work sits at the intersection of analytics consulting, research reporting, data preparation, and mixed-methods interpretation.

The goal is simple: make data easier to inspect, explain, and use. That can mean a dashboard, a report, a cleaned dataset, a qualitative coding workflow, an automated reporting process, or a concise findings brief.

## Methods

:::: {.index-list}
::: {.index-item}
### Reproducible Data Work

Projects should have visible assumptions, source notes, clean intermediate outputs, and enough documentation for someone else to understand the path from raw material to finding.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Decision-Oriented Reporting

Reports and dashboards should be readable under real constraints: clear definitions, useful comparisons, plain-language findings, and charts that serve the question.
:::

::: {.index-item}
### Qualitative and Mixed-Methods Analysis

Open-ended data, transcripts, survey responses, and context notes can be structured carefully without flattening the nuance that makes them useful.
:::
::::

:::: {.index-list}

## Contact Context

Good-fit projects usually involve messy but valuable source material, unclear reporting processes, recurring manual work, research questions that need structure, or stakeholders who need a clearer explanation of the evidence.

For questions, project fit, or collaboration, contact [jonathonsun03@gmail.com](mailto:jonathonsun03@gmail.com).
